title: Joining Pocketwire Rewards: Enrolment Conditions and Starting Tier
content:
Enrolment in Pocketwire Rewards is open to a customer whose personal account is active and who holds a Pocketwire debit card that is ordered, active or locked, because points are earned only on Pocketwire debit card purchases.

## Terms of enrolment

1. The conditions are read from the system records before enrolment: the status of the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account, and the status of the Pocketwire debit card the customer holds. The personal account named in the enrolment is the one whose record is read.
2. Points are earned only on Pocketwire debit card purchases. P2P payments, cash-outs, ATM withdrawals, fees and internal transfers never earn points.
3. Every membership starts at Pocketwire Rewards Member on the enrolment date, with its first tier review on the first day of the next calendar quarter.
4. A customer's spend before enrolment never counts toward points or tier.
5. The membership becomes active by itself when the first points are credited; until then it is enrolled.

## The enrolment condition in two parts

| Part | What the records must show |
|---|---|
| Personal account | status active |
| Debit card | a Pocketwire debit card with status ordered, active or locked |

Both parts belong to one condition: an active personal account and a card in one of the three listed statuses. A card that is ordered but not yet active already meets the card part, and so does a locked card.

## First tier review date (hypothetical enrolment dates)

| Enrolment date | Starting tier | First tier review |
|---|---|---|
| 14 May | Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1 July |
| 30 September | Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1 October |
| 1 January | Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1 April |

## Points of judgement

- A customer who paid a friend by P2P payment and cashed out the same week has earned nothing from either, before or after enrolment.
- Card purchases made the day before the enrolment date do not count toward points or tier, even though the card was already held.
